title: G6 (boundary): under-determination when lambda=0 or q<nr

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** the Tikhonov term $\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$ and the regime $n,r<q$.

If $\lambda=0$ or $q<nr$, the data term alone is rank-deficient and ($\star$) is under-determined; the preconditioner inverse and PCG behavior must be addressed for this boundary case. The statement fixes $\lambda$ as a regularizer but does not explicitly assert $\lambda>0$; the attempt should state the assumption used and handle the degenerate case (F2 boundary-case neglect).
